title: Updating an existing dictionary key
description: You can compare replacing a value with adding a new entry.

steps.description: menu maps food and drink names to prices. You look up bagel and insert its value 2 into the printed sentence.

steps.question: Will assigning 4 to coffee create a second coffee entry?
steps.answer: No. The existing key keeps one entry and its value changes from 3 to 4.

steps.description: You update coffee and then assign a value to the new key tea. That second assignment adds an entry.
The printed menu contains four keys. You see coffee at 4 and tea at 2, alongside the original bagel and muffin values.
